en.title: Tales From the Darkside Producer Jerry Golod Dies at 87
en.summary: Jerry Golod, the visionary producer behind the beloved anthology series 'Tales From the Darkside,' has passed away at the age of 87. His legacy extends beyond horror, encompassing significant executive roles at CBS and NBC.
en.body:
The television landscape has lost a significant figure with the passing of **Jerry Golod**, the producer who brought the chilling tales of **Tales From the Darkside** to screens. Golod died at his home in Rancho Mirage, California, following a brief battle with cancer. He was 87 years old.

Before establishing his own production company, JayGee Productions, in the early 1980s, Golod honed his executive eye at major networks, serving in leadership roles at both CBS and NBC. This foundational experience in broadcast television undoubtedly shaped his later success as a producer, allowing him to understand the intricacies of network programming and audience appeal. His work on **Tales From the Darkside** is particularly noteworthy, a series that captured the imagination of fans with its blend of psychological horror, dark fantasy, and often surprising twists, proving that audiences were hungry for sophisticated genre storytelling.

## A Legacy Beyond the Darkside

Golod's career demonstrates a keen ability to identify and nurture compelling narratives. His tenure at CBS and NBC saw him involved in programming decisions that defined television for millions. Later, founding JayGee Productions allowed him to pivot from executive oversight to hands-on producing, bringing projects like **Tales From the Darkside** to fruition. The series, which ran from 1983 to 1988, became a cult favorite and is remembered for its high-quality production values and its ability to deliver genuinely unsettling stories within its anthology format. It offered a platform for unique voices and imaginative concepts, a testament to Golod's vision.

## What This Means for Fans

The passing of a producer like Golod often sparks a wave of nostalgia and appreciation among dedicated fans. **Tales From the Darkside** remains a benchmark for anthology horror, influencing subsequent series and continuing to be discovered by new generations of viewers through streaming and reruns. For those who grew up with the show, or discovered its eerie charm later, Golod's work represents a significant contribution to television's darker side. Discussions online are likely to center on favorite episodes, the show's unique atmosphere, and the enduring impact of its storytelling.

## Looking Ahead

While details regarding memorial services have not been announced, the legacy of Jerry Golod will continue to live on through the enduring popularity of **Tales From the Darkside** and the careers he helped shape during his extensive time in television. Fans can revisit the series on various streaming platforms to celebrate his remarkable contributions.
